snippets.ELLA_SPIES_07: I'm sure she has a good reason for it...
snippets.ELLA_SPIES_11: Not a very good idea, Max...
snippets.ELLA_SPIES_18: Oh, Professor Bookworm also has his paws in this?
snippets.ELLA_SPIES_20: Wake up, Ella, this must just be a bad dream...
snippets.ELLA_SPIES_30: That can't go well, I must think of a back-up plan...
snippets.ELLA_SPIES_80: Hold on tight, both of you!
snippets.ELLA_SPIES_83: I'm sure you would have, Max, I'm sure...
snippets.MAX_SPIES_03: Have a look yourself! You'll see it better through the telescope.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_04: It shows the front side of the castle of Bitterland directly. I don't like what you can see there at all.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_05: Nasty looking guards and Pandas working like slaves - that's not right! We must look into this more closely.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_05A: And Kamaria doesn't like to talk about it.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_06: I don't understand it, usually she stands by us in these situations! There's something not right about this...
snippets.MAX_SPIES_08: If Kamaria can't help us, we need to take the matter into our own hands! Otherwise bad things will happen!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_09: Evron and his henchmen mean trouble! We almost lost Paul the kid to him already and who knows what he's up to next!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_09A: We need to find out what's going on, $$name$$! We must get a disguise!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_10: Yeah! We'll wear disguises and snoop around a bit.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_12: As super spies, we'll need a disguise!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_13: Luckily Lili always has some costumes ready.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_14: The Sniff and Snoop Collection 3000! The hottest thing in spy fashion.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_14A: In this disguise, the guards will never recognise us!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_16A: No professional super spy goes on a mission without his camera!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_17: Here you go, $$name$$. With friendly greetings from Professor Bookworm.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_19A: The camera's not the only thing that the Professor has prepared for us.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_22: Let me present to you: Bookworm's bombastic boat! Made for holidays, class excursions and spy missions!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_25: The Professor assured me that we only need to use the lever in the prop airliner.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_25A: The rest is taken care of by the fireflies inside the boat. Crazy, eh?
snippets.MAX_SPIES_27: Yes, $$name$$, keep going! We're taking off! We're really taking off!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_28: Take care, Ella! Eyes open, super spies!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_32: Be careful, $$name$$! The balloon knots are loosening! We don't want to land yet!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_33: Woah, that was close, but we made it. Good job!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_34: Wooooaaah, look out, $$name$$! The sail is out of control, grab it!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_35: Ha! Nice work. It would be silly if a sail had outsmarted us, eh?
snippets.MAX_SPIES_36: Now I'm sure nothing can happen to us anymore.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_37: Oh, there's one of those tiny fireflies... It looks cute...
snippets.MAX_SPIES_39: The Boat is on fire!!! The boat is on fire, $$name$$!!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_40: Wow, $$name$$! That was really close! I don't think I should trust these little fireflies anymore.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_41: But now we've reached our goal! We still need to land.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_42: That's easy! The Professor has given us his invention, the "SILD".
snippets.MAX_SPIES_43: It's the "Super Intelligent Landing Device". "Can be used in all circumstances"... "The higher the better"... Well, it's exciting to see what it's like.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_44: It's right next to you, $$name$$. Just unwrap it.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_45: A needle?! Is that really the professor's "Super Intelligent Landing Device"?! Yikes...
snippets.MAX_SPIES_46: Well then we'll just prick each balloon separately, so it will bring us to the ground slowly.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_48: Help! Help! Am I dead? I see a light at the end of the tunnel!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_51: ...$$name$$! Oh, it was just a small tumble. It's nothing.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_52: Do you see that?! These Pandas are forced to work! They look really weak and sad, and they're full of...
snippets.MAX_SPIES_53: And the others seem quite grim. They must be the supervisors. They are in for a surprise!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_54: Woah, that must've hurt! Maybe we should think of a plan first.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_55: Let's see... These guards only let workers through. We don't exactly look like weary workers.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_56: I can't think when I'm standing, it's better to sit down.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_58: Hmm, "can be used in all circumstances", eh? Ouch. Well, maybe we could use the needle somehow?
snippets.MAX_SPIES_59: Oh, what are you thinking of using the flour for? Should we...
snippets.MAX_SPIES_60: You're a genius $$name$$! But don't forget to disguise me too.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_61: So far so good! But we still don't look like those poor worker Pandas. Something's missing.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_62: Quick hands, $$name$$. Please give me a sack too.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_63: We're unrecognisable, $$name$$! We'll most definitely fool the guards now!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_65: You go first, $$name$$. I'll be right behind you.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_66: Brrr! It's creepy here! But we didn't come all this way to turn back now.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_67: It looks like we won't be getting any further from here though... unless...
snippets.MAX_SPIES_71: Sneak past the guards and put the sack on the pile. Be as invisible as you can.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_72: I'll distract the guards while you take a photo from inside the castle. Before they know what hit them we'll be long gone.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_76: I'm afraid this is the end.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_77: It's an honour to spend my last moments with you, $$name$$.
snippets.MAX_SPIES_78: I wish I could still see Ella one more time...
snippets.MAX_SPIES_82: But we could've made it by ourselves! We would've showed them who's boss!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_NONWALK01: Behind the bushes the guards can't see us! We need to find a safe way past them!
snippets.MAX_SPIES_NONWALK02: Lay the sack on the pile with the others, $$name$$.
snippets.SPIES_JOURNAL_PROGRESS_03:
The secret lies behind the gate! There's just no way past the guards... Maybe Max has an idea?
You disguised yourself as workers and fooled the guards on the road. You're now in front of the castle entrance.
snippets.SPIES_JOURNAL_PROGRESS_04:
We made it! Bravely you snapped a photo of the suspicious events inside the castle. But what can we see in it? Meet Max and study the photo more carefully together.
While Max cleverly distracted the guards, you were able to sneak into the castle and take a photo of an extraordinary machine. Despite all of your efforts, your cover was blown. In the last moment, thanks to Ella, we were able to flee.
snippets.SPIES_JOURNAL_SUMMARY: Something strange is going on. You must go to Bitterland, and find out what Evron and his henchmen are up to. Talk to Max.
